sourceTitle: Parts and stock on the job
observedAudience: Owners and office staff who schedule, dispatch and record field jobs. No developer knowledge is needed.
observedLearningOutcomes: Attach required parts to a template or job so the right items travel with the worker.
Explain how a request, a transfer and a used-parts record connect.
Record a return with its reason.
